video.title: Top 5 Life Insurance Companies in USA

summary: A Casper Capital listicle ranking five US life insurance providers: Corebridge Financial, Ladder Life, AAA (transcribed as AMA), Northwestern Mutual and New York Life. It explains term vs permanent (whole, universal, indexed universal) life insurance, cash value, conversion, dividends and accelerated death benefits, and who each insurer suits. It contains no business idea; it is consumer finance content with quote-comparison links in the description. Takeaway: term gives the most cover per dollar; permanent adds savings at higher cost.

tactics.name: Choosing life insurance
steps: Match a term length (10-35 years) to mortgage or working years
Use online term providers for speed and price
Choose advisor-led mutuals for permanent cover with dividends
Compare quotes and read the fine print by state

lessons.lesson: Term life gives the most coverage for the lowest price; permanent adds a savings component.
Conversion options let you move from term to permanent without a new exam.
Online-first providers trade advice depth for speed and price.
